Born as `offered`, exactly like an agent's own `offer_handoff` — the only difference is who decided. `toAgent` has to be in the addressable catalog (area lead or area-less agent); a subagent or an unknown slug is refused with 400. At most one pending offer per (project, target): see `desfecho` (ADR 0182, RN-635).
